summary: As of 2026-10-01, Greg Abel is the Chief Executive Officer of Berkshire Hathaway. He was appointed to the role effective January 1, 2026 per the company's 2025 Form 10-K, and Warren Buffett's September 2026 shareholder letter confirms he was running the company nine months into his tenure.

findings.statement: Greg Abel's full name is Gregory Edward Abel, born June 1, 1962.
According to Berkshire Hathaway's 2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC, Greg Abel was appointed to become Chief Executive Officer effective January 1, 2026.
Warren Buffett's September 18, 2026 shareholder letter described Greg Abel as running the company, confirming his CEO role as of September 2026.
